description: A limiter for a stereo pair, with a make-up gain after it

params.text: Sets the voltage past which the signal is squeezed, 10V leaving it alone and 0V squeezing everything; the lamp under it lights while the limiter is working
Multiplies the limited signal by 0 to 10; the lamp under it lights when the result passes 10V

inputs.text: One of the two signals to be limited

outputs.text: That side of the limited and made-up signal

notes: with nothing patched into one of the inputs, that side of the output holds a steady voltage set by MAKE UP, 0V to 10V
